[EN] Hide and Go Seek
[ES] Las Escondidas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Keep an eye out for her, will you?
[ES] No la pierdas de vista, ¿quieres?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I hope I'm not interrupting you.
[ES] Espero no estar interrumpiéndote.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right away."
[ES] "Enseguida."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look for Wilene near the Zaeltarazad Shrine.
[ES] Busca a Wilene cerca del Zaeltarazad Shrine.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Mekonari summoners east of Zaeltarazad Shrine are up to no good. Send them packing.
[ES] Los invocadores mekonari al este del Zaeltarazad Shrine están tramando algo malo. Dales su merecido.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For Wyrmgorge!"
[ES] ¡Por Wyrmgorge!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Ramsleigh's scout, Wilene, at Zaeltarazad Shrine.
[ES] Encuentra a la exploradora de Ramsleigh, Wilene, en el Zaeltarazad Shrine.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to be of service."
[ES] Encantado de servir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Tesran at Jagged Crest.
[ES] Preséntate ante Tesran en Jagged Crest.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
